payload.contentHtml:
@levelsio
I hate tmux

It's so incredibly user unfriendly

The shortcuts make no sense

I wish someone would make a better tmux

Even just logging into tmux attaching the screen is an illogical hell to type

Again I hate tmux, it's so shit
@SpaceMatthieu

Is there a good way to jump between tmux sessions on Termius? I find it quite hard to manage multiple codex/claude sessions on the go

热门回复

@Jeremy Howard ♥ 258 · 💬 18

Typing `tmux a` is too hard? I don't get it.

Of all the complicated and weird tools on linux to pick on, why tmux - it's so straightforward.

@@levelsio ♥ 33 · 💬 21

Example of how it's complicated

How to attach to my 2nd tmux screen:

> tmux ls
0: 1 windows (created Mon Mar 16 10:23:41 2026) [220x50] (attached)
1: 2 windows (created Mon Mar 16 11:45:02 2026) [220x50]
2: 1 windows (created Mon Mar 16 14:12:55 2026) [220x50]

> tmux a -t 1

@cyrus ♥ 61 · 💬 4

Tmux is super hackable so it’s really skill issue

@Johannes Schmidt ♥ 49 · 💬 5

i made a better TMUX it's called MidTerm

it runs on all my servers -> those are all on tailscale and then i can just run multiple agents and terminal programs.

@Yuri Kushch ♥ 41 · 💬 2

Try this one
https://
zellij.dev it’s easier to use and shortcuts make more sense
